name: Chimichurri Sauce
desc: Uncooked parsley, garlic, red chili, oregano, and red wine vinegar sauce for grilled meats.

source.title: Authentic Chimichurri (Uruguay & Argentina)
source.evidence: Identical ingredient list and amounts (1/2 cup oil, 2 tbsp red wine vinegar, 1/2 cup parsley, 3-4 garlic cloves, 2 red chilies, 3/4 tsp oregano, 1 tsp salt, 1/2 tsp pepper) and the same rest-then-baste method.

ingredients.raw: 1/2 cup fresh flat-leaf parsley, finely chopped
3-4 garlic cloves, finely chopped or minced
2 small red chilies, deseeded and finely chopped (or 1 larger red chili, about 1 tbsp chopped)
ingredients.note: or 1 larger red chili, about 1 tbsp chopped

steps: Finely chop the parsley, garlic, and chili. Add the garlic and chili a little at a time until it tastes right to you.
Stir everything together in a bowl.
Let sit 5 to 10 minutes so the flavors move into the oil, ideally 2 hours or more.
Brush it on chicken or steak while grilling, or spoon it over steak to serve.
tips: Cafe Delites recommends basting with it rather than using it as a marinade.

references.title: Authentic Chimichurri (Uruguay & Argentina)
references.usedFor: ingredient prep (finely chopped, deseeded chili), rest time, basting use, yield
